scope: Qt 6.10.3 third-party component and license evidence for the fixed Windows x64 product staging. Materials for review; not a legal redistribution conclusion.

binary_file_checksums.note: The SBOM ships in the pinned binary archive, but its packaged-file SHA-1 values do not match the archived SDK binaries. Per-file byte identity therefore comes from the pinned archive/SDK tree identity, not from SBOM file checksums.

method.deployed_file_mapping: Each staged Qt library/plugin maps to the single non-Debug SBOM packaged file; its owning SBOM package supplies the module/plugin class.
method.component_mapping: Third-party packages reached from the owning package through DEPENDS_ON edges are included; traversal follows only third-party packages and stops at internal Qt packages. Existence in the source tree alone is not treated as shipped.
method.attribution_cross_check: Each component's SBOM package comment is resolved to a qt_attribution.json member and entry index in the pinned source archive; Id, license ids, version and license files are verified.
method.license_texts: Canonical LICENSES/<id>.txt files come from the same pinned source archive; component-specific upstream license files are recorded by member and SHA-256.
